summary: Iter-70 tested Sections 7 (Parrainage) and 8 (Porte-monnaie / Fidélité) end to end. Backend pytest: 16/16 PASS (test_iter70_wallet_referral.py). It covers: referral code check (case-insensitive, 404 for an invalid code), invalid code blocks signup (400), opens counted once per visitor_id, filleule +1000 available / marraine +1000 pending, account referral rules/stats/items, the checkout wallet debit (total = sub + fee - wallet, same checkout_key gives the same order with no 2nd debit, a request above the balance only debits what is available, capped by the articles subtotal, guests get no wallet), cancel refunds exactly once (annulee -> nouvelle -> annulee), delivering twice awards points once and releases the marraine reward once (status recompensee), conversion (<100 -> 400, more than owned -> 400, 120 pts -> 1200 FCFA, same key replayed -> no double credit), console wallet adjust (reason mandatory, amount 0 -> 400, overdraft -> 400, negative correction ok, audit_log written), and RBAC (sales gets 403 on /wallet/transactions and adjust; unauthenticated gets 401). A parallel race of 6 concurrent submits with the same checkout_key gave 1 order and 1 debit. Frontend (Playwright 1920x1080 + 390x844): invitation-invalid works. invitation-page shows the first name, code and 1,000 FCFA and stores dina_ref. invitation-signup opens signup with 'Oui' selected and the code prefilled; signup-referral-ok and -ko validate live; an invalid code blocks the submit; a valid signup lands on account-shell and dina_ref is cleared; 'Non' hides the code field and gives wallet 0. Porte-monnaie shows balance/pending/earned/used, by-source chips and ledger rows. Parrainage shows code, link, copy toast, rules, stats, earned/pending and items going Inscrite -> 1re commande en cours -> Récompense versée · +1,000 FCFA. Fidélité: button disabled under 100 points; converting 120 points gives 1,200 FCFA and 0 points, and a double-click converts once. Checkout with a wallet: the toggle auto-fills the max, partial 400 works, Max works, total = 29,500 + 1,500 - 1,000 = 30,000, the order is created with wallet_used 1000 and the ledger debit shows. Console Paiements tab: console-wallet balance/pending/used/points; adjust without a reason gives the 'Motif obligatoire' toast; with a reason, +250 updates the balance and history ('par Aïcha Ouattara'). /console/parrainage shows statuses (Récompensé · DN-…, En attente 1re livraison) and wallet-tx-filter works (Remboursement). Found 1 HIGH UI bug (account sidebar navigation) and 1 HIGH security config issue (CORS + SameSite=None).

critical.endpoint: ALL cookie-authenticated customer endpoints (/api/public/account/wallet, /wallet/convert, /api/public/orders with wallet_use, /account/referral)
critical.issue: CORSMiddleware uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True, so Starlette echoes back ANY Origin (verified: Origin https://evil.com -> access-control-allow-origin: https://evil.com + allow-credentials: true). The customer_token cookie is SameSite=None. Any third-party site can read a logged-in customer's wallet/referral data and place orders that spend her wallet. Use an explicit origin list from env (CORS_ORIGINS) instead of '*'.

minor.issue: checkout_key idempotency is a find-then-insert with no unique index on orders.checkout_key. The race test passed, but two truly concurrent requests could create 2 orders and 2 wallet debits (refs order:{oid} differ). Add a sparse unique index on checkout_key and catch DuplicateKey.
The wallet is debited BEFORE stock updates/order insert. If anything after debit_for_order raises, the customer loses wallet money with no order. Insert the order first, or refund in an except block.

referral_code = DINA-{random 1000-9999}, with no uniqueness check and no unique index on customers.referral_code. There are only 9000 codes, so collisions will happen as the base grows, and find_marraine then credits the wrong marraine.
Any staff role (get_user), including riders and stock staff, can read a customer's wallet. Consider require_role(admin, manager, sales).
Uses fields user/user_id/customer_id, while other audit entries use user_name/entity_id/before/after. The console Historique/audit views may not show the author/entity consistently.

The cookie takes precedence over the Authorization Bearer header. A stale customer_token cookie from another account overrides the explicit Bearer token (seen in testing: localStorage session of A, but API returned B).

ui_bugs.issue: MENU uses relative 'to' values ('', 'commandes', 'parrainage', ...) inside the splat route 'compte/*' (react-router-dom 7.18 resolves relative to the full splat path). On any sub-page the links become /boutique/compte/parrainage/porte-monnaie, /boutique/compte/parrainage/commandes, etc. Clicking a second menu item renders an EMPTY content pane. 'Mon compte' is highlighted as active on every sub-page and the real current item is never highlighted. Reproduce: /boutique/compte -> Parrainage (ok) -> Porte-monnaie => URL /boutique/compte/parrainage/porte-monnaie, blank. Fix: to={`/boutique/compte${m.to ? '/' + m.to : ''}`}.

API errors are swallowed (.catch(() => {})), so on 401 (e.g. cookie missing while the localStorage session is valid) the page shows 'Chargement…' forever with no error state or retry. The customer api client only relies on the cookie and does not send the customer Bearer token.
Debit rows show status 'Crédité · solde 0 FCFA' (the STATUS label for 'available' is used for debits too). It should read 'Débité' or 'Effectué' for negative amounts.
The input accepts values above the max (e.g. 99999 stays visible) while only 1,000 is applied. Clamp the input value to walletMax on change/blur.

integration_issues.issue: After an adjust, the header KPI 'PORTEFEUILLE' stays at the old value (1,000) while console-wallet-balance shows 1,250. The customer detail is not refetched.

issues: fcfa() formats with an English thousands comma ('1,000 FCFA', '29,500 FCFA'). French should use a space: '1 000 FCFA'.
Porte-monnaie 'Disponible' card: the balance '1,000 FCFA' wraps onto 2 lines at 1920px because of the text-3xl column width.

action_items: HIGH: Fix the AccountShell desktop NavLink 'to' values: use absolute paths (/boutique/compte/...) so menu navigation and the active state work from sub-pages.
HIGH: Restrict CORS to explicit origins (no '*' with allow_credentials) because SameSite=None customer cookies now guard money (wallet).
Add a unique sparse index on orders.checkout_key and handle DuplicateKey. Move the wallet debit after a successful order insert, or refund on exception.
Make referral_code unique: retry generation and add a unique index on customers.referral_code.
Add error/401 states to Referral/WalletPage/Loyalty instead of an infinite 'Chargement…'.
WalletLedger: show a 'Débité' label for negative rows. Clamp checkout-wallet-amount. Refresh the console header KPI after a wallet adjust.
critical_code_review_comments: wallet.move(): atomic $inc with a $gte guard plus a unique ref index (wallet_tx.ref_1 exists) gives correct idempotency; the duplicate path undoes the $inc. Good.

on_order_status(): points base = subtotal - discount - wallet_used. Spec says '1 point per 500 FCFA of articles'; confirm with the business whether the wallet-paid part should earn points (currently it does not).

Refund on cancel is idempotent via the ref refund:{oid}. But if a cancelled order is re-activated (annulee -> nouvelle -> livree), the wallet is not re-debited, so the customer keeps both the refund and the goods. Consider blocking re-activation of cancelled orders that had wallet_used, or re-debiting.
public_create_order trusts client-sent item prices/discount (pre-existing). The wallet eligible amount is derived from those client values.
PATCH /api/orders/{id}/status has no role restriction (any staff can set livree/annulee, which triggers wallet credits/refunds).
Loyalty conversion key `${Date.now()}-${n}` is regenerated per click, so idempotency only relies on the busy flag. A server-side replay with the same key is safe (tested).
AccountShell.jsx is 1017 lines: split Loyalty/Referral/WalletPage/Addresses into separate files.

success_rate.backend: 100% (16/16 pytest) - 1 HIGH security config issue + minor robustness issues
success_rate.frontend: ~90% - all section 7/8 flows work; desktop account sidebar navigation broken from sub-pages

rca of the issue: Sidebar: react-router-dom v7 has v7_relativeSplatPath on by default. AccountShell is mounted at 'compte/*', so a relative NavLink 'porte-monnaie' resolves against /boutique/compte/parrainage and gives /boutique/compte/parrainage/porte-monnaie, which matches no inner <Route>, so the content is blank. Mitigation: absolute paths. CORS: Starlette CORSMiddleware with allow_origins=['*'] and allow_credentials=True echoes the request Origin. Mitigation: explicit origins from env.
